subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — DST calendar conflict and recording fallback

Subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — proposed slots + agenda (attached)

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call, we'd like to lock in a 60–90 minute Renewal QBR + roadmap demo where we'll:
- highlight the performance/cost improvements we've rolled out this quarter
- walk through the recommended routing and caching changes for your high-volume flows
- capture your success criteria for next 12 months and map a playbook

Proposed windows (ET):
- Thursday Nov 4, 10:00–11:30 AM ET
- Friday Nov 5, 2:00–3:30 PM ET
- Monday Nov 8, 9:00–10:30 AM ET (backup)

One note: the US falls back to standard time on Nov 1. I want to avoid confusion for your UK/APAC stakeholders — if anyone is joining from London or Sydney, please confirm whether they’re on local DST or standard time so we don’t double-book.

Attached is an agenda draft (QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a short terms summary. If we need an exec-only sync before the full session, we can do a 20-minute prep.

Would Friday Nov 5 at 2pm ET work for you if we record the session and share a condensed recording for those who can’t make it?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Sofia — thanks for sending. Friday Nov 5 at 2pm ET looks good for the product team and Alex (CTO) in the US. A couple quick items: 

1) We have stakeholders in London and one engineer in Bangalore. The London team will be on GMT (no DST) by Nov 5; Bangalore is unaffected. Please confirm recording + whether you'll post a short pre-read.
2) Procurement wants the renewal PO to be ready the week of Nov 8 — I’ve looped procurement@clearwavehealth.com. They asked for a one-page SLT and a copy of the terms summary you attached.

If possible, can we move to Nov 6 11am ET instead? That gives procurement a business day to review before Nov 8. If not, Nov 5 is still workable.

Jamie
